text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of the blue, Tamamo Cross receives some devastating news from her family… Her mother has fallen ill and collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's nothing life-threatening, the news affects Tamamo Cross's concentration, resulting in her getting involved in an accident during her next scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she emerges from the collision with only bruises, she develops a fear of running in a high-speed pack.
